subject: Very simple example of a javascript component doing all the Input and Output with Shiny

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Very simple example of a javascript component doing all the Input and Output with Shiny
parts:
I am building d3 tools with a shiny backend.  I want to allow d3 to accept a first minimal data set, and then ask for extra data as required.

I have built a toy example of a <div><script> that is both input and output, and requests new data each time a transition is complete.

https://gist.github.com/4358023

Please please critique and suggest better methods - I've only been using any of shiny or javascript or d3 for about 5 days.  R for about 5 years, tho.

It's not intended to be visually impressive - I wanted to keep the code real simple.

-Alex
